name: bEarn BUSD/ibBUSD withdrawal-unit mismatch
summary: The BUSD Alpaca strategy's withdraw(address,uint256) passed a BUSD-denominated request to FairLaunch as an ibBUSD amount. Because each ibBUSD was worth more than one BUSD, repeated deposit/emergencyWithdraw cycles withdrew excess BUSD and compounded the attacker's credit.

loss.notes: bEarn reports that 26 attack transactions beginning with the anchored transaction drained 10,859,319 BUSD from the affected single-stake BUSD vault. The campaign-wide amount is valued at stablecoin par; it is not narrowed to the first transaction's proceeds.

ageReset.description: The direct BUSD Alpaca strategy was deployed with the flawed withdrawal-unit handling and its runtime remained byte-identical immediately before the incident.

sources.note: Reviewed the first exploit receipt and 1,000-plus-frame call trace, the strategy creation transaction and receipt, historical runtime and EIP-1967 slot, runtime disassembly, the bank proxy's upgrade history, the commit-pinned reproduction, and bEarn's post-mortem. Each of the 33 deposit/emergencyWithdraw iterations in the anchor causes bVault 0xb390b07fcf76678089cb12d8e615d5fe494b01fb to call BUSD Alpaca strategy 0x21125d94cfe886e7179c8d2fe8c1ea8d57c73e0e directly, including 33 calls to selector 0xf3fef3a3, withdraw(address,uint256). The post-mortem locates the defect in that strategy function: its BUSD-denominated wantAmount was used as an ibBUSD withdrawal amount. The strategy is a direct 23,127-byte contract created in transaction 0xdd4031277401d5eca44cc73e153effaee20a983b5b513cbf517e08cc9a9911db. Its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT, is byte-identical at deployment and block 7457124, and hashes to 0xada77033047849187832a245e0e1f814d255430597cfce06d3a321ebd117e1cd. The bank's implementation upgrade 328,768 seconds before exploitation does not install or change this defect-executing strategy and is excluded from its age. The anchored helper gains 452,868.889740007548480164 BUSD in the first transaction; bEarn's 10,859,319-BUSD loss is the broader 26-transaction campaign total.

limitations: The campaign-wide BUSD amount follows bEarn's primary post-mortem rather than a complete structured set of all 26 attack transaction hashes.

notes: The defect-executing target is the direct BUSD Alpaca strategy, not the bVault bank proxy through which users entered and exited the strategy.
